SUBJECT:
U. S. Department of Interior: Draft Environmental
Impact Statement On Endangered Species Conservation
Act of 1972, SPDC Project No. 72-0949
The Department of Natural Resources, and in-particular our Division of Recreation and Parks, endorses the concept set forth for the protection of endangered species by the Endangered Species Conservation Act of 1972. Upon the implementation of this Legistlation we will provide assistance as needed to the Department of Interior in aiding in the datermination of what species in Fromida should be placed on the endangered list. Additionally, we will assist in recommending procedures to insure the protection of those species which are placed on the endangered list.
In our review of the subject Environmental Impact Statement we have assumed that private rights involving lands designated as habitat for endangered species are subject to all existing laws and eminent domain precedures thus protecting the rights of such individuals.
